rows.name:
The team investigating the ruins found an old document.[XENO:n ]
It'll take time to decipher because of its age.[XENO:n ]
Gather materials to build a deciphering device.

Obtain 6 pieces of [System:Color name=item ]Sturdy Armour[/System:Color][XENO:n ]
from Flavel Andos in Eryth Sea.
Report to Russ.

The deciphering device is complete.[XENO:n ]
Deciphering the document should progress now.

The deciphering device you made seems too imprecise.[XENO:n ]
At this rate, you won't make any progress on the[XENO:n ]
document. Gather materials to improve the device.

Collect 5 [System:Color name=item ]Green Diodes[/System:Color][XENO:n ]
in the High Entia Tomb.

Obtain 3 [System:Color name=item ]Astas Remote Units[/System:Color][XENO:n ]
from Hover Astas in the High Entia Tomb.
Report to Natori.

You improved the device and deciphered more of the text.[XENO:n ]
It seems to concern the High Entia's War God.

You learned Talia was heading to the Satorl ruins alone.[XENO:n ]
You warned her of the danger, but she won't change her mind.[XENO:n ]
You're worried about her, so follow her!

Near Judgment Chamber in Satorl Marsh,[XENO:n ]
defeat [System:Color name=item ]Dogmatic Gogol[/System:Color].
Talk to Talia.

You changed the future in which Talia would die.[XENO:n ]
She and the others seem to seek the true War God statue.

Melissa's son apparently just went to Eryth Sea to train.[XENO:n ]
It's dangerous there, so she wants him brought back.[XENO:n ]
Look for Mirallis.
Find Mirallis at Eryth Sea.
Report to Melissa.

Maybe he regrets worrying his mother. He apparently[XENO:n ]
vowed to stop being reckless. She can rest easy.

Mirallis stopped being reckless and will study under Coles.[XENO:n ]
But Coles lacks materials and can't take him on yet.[XENO:n ]
Ask Coles what teaching materials he needs.
Talk to Coles.

Obtain 3 portions of [System:Color name=item ]Eluca Bitter Water[/System:Color][XENO:n ]
from Perna Elucas in Eryth Sea.
Talk to Coles.
Report to Mirallis.

With all the teaching materials gathered,[XENO:n ]
Mirallis seems able to study under Coles now.

Mirallis says the monster population in Eryth Sea[XENO:n ]
seems to have grown alarmingly.[XENO:n ]
Help the guards protect Achamoth.
Talk to Rokuro.

Defeat 2 [System:Color name=item ]Buono Nebulae[/System:Color][XENO:n ]
in Eryth Sea.
Report to Rokuro.
Report to Mirallis.

You defeated monsters in Eryth Sea to protect the capital.[XENO:n ]
Mirallis looked happy to be praised by Rokuro.

While handling Mirallis' request, you were also asked[XENO:n ]
by Rokuro to defeat some monsters.[XENO:n ]
Finish that task before reporting to Rokuro.

Defeat 2 [System:Color name=item ]Bono Nebulae[/System:Color][XENO:n ]
in Eryth Sea.

You defeated the requested monsters,[XENO:n ]
so none of the guards were killed or injured.

Seagal seems to have fallen for two women,[XENO:n ]
Rosa and Riko.[XENO:n ]
He asked you to find out how they feel about him now.
Talk to Riko.
Talk to Rosa.
Report to Seagal.

You found out how the two women feel about him.[XENO:n ]
Neither of them dislikes him.

Both women finally confessed their feelings to Seagal,[XENO:n ]
but he can't decide which one to choose.[XENO:n ]
He asked you to find out their fondest memories.
Talk to Rosa or Riko.
Talk to Rosa.
Talk to Riko.
Report to Seagal.

Hearing Riko's fondest memory made Seagal realise[XENO:n ]
his true feelings, and he decided to confess to Riko.

Hearing Rosa's fondest memory made Seagal realise[XENO:n ]
his true feelings, and he decided to confess to Rosa.

Seagal has finally decided to confess to Riko.[XENO:n ]
He can't go himself because Rosa is nearby.[XENO:n ]
Deliver his love letter for him.
Talk to Riko.
Report to Seagal.

When you delivered Seagal's letter,[XENO:n ]
Riko cried, but the two ended up dating.

Seagal has decided how to respond to Rosa's confession.[XENO:n ]
Riko is nearby every day, so he can't go in person.[XENO:n ]
Deliver his love letter for him.
Talk to Rosa.
Report to Seagal.

Rosa seems to have had a lot on her mind,[XENO:n ]
but she accepted his feelings and they began dating.

They planned to help a close friend defeat monsters,[XENO:n ]
but a monster-slaying assignment came up.[XENO:n ]
Take care of the assignment for them.

Defeat 6 [System:Color name=item ]Eryth Hiruns[/System:Color][XENO:n ]
in Eryth Sea.
Report to Rokuro.

You completed their monster-slaying assignment.[XENO:n ]
They seem to have succeeded too. The best possible outcome.

They need water that won't freeze for their next journey,[XENO:n ]
but apparently there are no waterfalls nearby.[XENO:n ]
Visit waterfalls around the world to collect water for him.

At Kasharpa Falls on the Giant God's Leg,[XENO:n ]
obtain [System:Color name=item ]Kasharpa Water[/System:Color].

Near the Sororal Statues in Satorl Marsh,[XENO:n ]
obtain [System:Color name=item ]Sister Statues Water[/System:Color].

At Great Makna Falls in Makna Forest,[XENO:n ]
obtain [System:Color name=item ]Makna Water[/System:Color].
Report to Zain.

You collected waterfall water and gave it to Zain.[XENO:n ]
They now have drinking water for the next adventure.

He apparently dropped the cream needed in cold regions.[XENO:n ]
It should be somewhere near an ether deposit[XENO:n ]
in Eryth Sea, so go look for it.

Near Anu Shore in Eryth Sea,[XENO:n ]
obtain the [System:Color name=item ]Chalk Container[/System:Color].
Report to Krall.

You found the container near Eryth Sea's ether deposit[XENO:n ]
and delivered it to Krall, Zain's partner.

Defeat Lakebed Orthlus in Colony 9 and obtain[XENO:n ]
Orthlus' Liver. It's apparently vital[XENO:n ]
for Zain and his partner's next adventure.

Near Agora Shore in Colony 9,[XENO:n ]
obtain [System:Color name=item ]Orthlus' Liver[/System:Color].
Report to Zain.

You gave Zain Orthlus' Liver, to use as preserved food.[XENO:n ]
They're ready and will apparently set off soon.

No word from the pair who went to Valak Mountain's ruins.[XENO:n ]
An accident might have left them unable to move.[XENO:n ]
Hurry to the mountain, find them and bring them home!

Find Zain near 3 Great Sages' Summit on[XENO:n ]
Valak Mountain.

Find Krall near 3 Great Sages' Summit on[XENO:n ]
Valak Mountain.
Report to Milia.

You found the two stranded after a monster attack[XENO:n ]
on the mountain, and brought them home safely.

Arietta's daughter suddenly took a dislike to other races.[XENO:n ]
Arietta wants you to find out why.[XENO:n ]
Talk to Louise and resolve the problem.
Talk to Louise.

Collect 2 pieces of [System:Color name=item ]Marine Marble[/System:Color][XENO:n ]
in Eryth Sea.
Talk to Louise.
Report to Arietta.

You discovered why Louise dislikes other races.[XENO:n ]
Let's hope her mother can persuade her[XENO:line ]

Apparently, Louise never used to care about race.[XENO:n ]
Recover her memories with Vivian[XENO:n ]
and restore their friendship.

Collect [System:Color name=item ]Morning Dew Ice[/System:Color] at Befalgar Pedestal[XENO:n ]
on Valak Mountain (early morning only).
Talk to Vivian.
Talk to Louise.
Report to Vivian.

Having recovered her memories, Louise seems to have[XENO:n ]
realised her mistake. The two are close friends again.

He wants to learn about stars to become an adventurer.[XENO:n ]
He asked you to put in a word with Milia, one of the[XENO:n ]
capital's greatest stargazers. Look for her.
Talk to Milia.

Obtain 2 [System:Color name=item ]Silver Eks Plates[/System:Color][XENO:n ]
from Stella Eks in Eryth Sea.
Talk to Milia.
Report to Ein.

With the telescope she made,[XENO:n ]
Ein has learned a little more about the stars.

To improve the view through the telescope Milia made,[XENO:n ]
he's looking for a nimble-fingered Nopon.[XENO:n ]
Find one and ask for help with his dream.
Talk to Galba.

In the Second Treasury of the High Entia Tomb,[XENO:n ]
obtain the [System:Color name=item ]Attachment Part[/System:Color].
Give the Attachment Part to Galba.
Report to Ein.

The telescope is improved and the stars are clearer.[XENO:n ]
Ein should learn more and more about them now.

Take the guard's extermination duty. Overtraining gave[XENO:n ]
him chronic back pain. Ease his friend's worries.

Defeat 6 [System:Color name=item ]Tehito Fuudis[/System:Color][XENO:n ]
in Eryth Sea.
Report to Guarda.

You completed the extermination assignment for them.[XENO:n ]
His friend promised not to overdo it again. What a relief.

Find insects for a promising boy. They apparently[XENO:n ]
glow golden for only a few hours after hatching.

Collect 9 [System:Color name=item ]Gold Caterpillars[/System:Color][XENO:n ]
in Tephra Cave.
Report to Tet.

You delivered the insects he asked for safely.[XENO:n ]
It'll be interesting to see his observations.

He wants to enjoy drinking with his friends but has[XENO:n ]
a low tolerance. He asked for food to build it up.[XENO:n ]
Gather ingredients so he can have fun with his friends.

Obtain 2 portions of [System:Color name=item ]Feris Wine Blood[/System:Color][XENO:n ]
from Feris in Makna Forest.

Obtain 5 [System:Color name=item ]Paguur Pot Grills[/System:Color][XENO:n ]
from Cruz Paguurs in Eryth Sea.
Report to Nero.

You gathered what Nero asked for and gave it to him.[XENO:n ]
He should be able to handle alcohol and enjoy it now.

While his two children were playing, his son[XENO:n ]
apparently disappeared without him noticing.[XENO:n ]
He can't leave, so look for his son for him.
Find Atael.
Report to Borario.

You found the missing son. He seems[XENO:n ]
to have returned safely to his father.

He looked away for a moment, and now his daughter is gone.[XENO:n ]
He can't leave here,[XENO:n ]
so go look for his daughter for him.
Find Kiino.
Report to Borario.

You found his daughter safely.[XENO:n ]
She'll probably stay with her father from now on.

Her son suddenly stopped wanting to go outside.[XENO:n ]
She wants you to somehow get him out of the house.[XENO:n ]
You don't know why, so talk to her son first.
Talk to Balor.

Collect 5 [System:Color name=item ]Ether Roses[/System:Color][XENO:n ]
in Satorl Marsh.
Talk to Balor.
Report to Popie.

You couldn't solve the problem keeping Balor indoors.[XENO:n ]
But you gave him what he asked for, so he should be fine.

You need a Secret Club Card to enter the club.[XENO:n ]
This is your chance, before they know they're exposed.[XENO:n ]
Hurry and find someone who has a card.
Find someone who has a Secret Club Card.

Obtain 3 [System:Color name=item ]Rufus Control Units[/System:Color][XENO:n ]
from Oruga Rufus in the High Entia Tomb.
Give them to Nero.

You obtained a Secret Club Card to enter the club.[XENO:n ]
Hurry back to the Secret Club!

The transporter stopped, trapping people in Whitewing Palace.[XENO:n ]
It's only a matter of time before Telethia find them.[XENO:n ]
Repair the Ether Furnace Controls to rescue them.

Find someone who can repair the Ether Furnace Controls[XENO:n ]
and ask how to repair them.

Repair the Ether Furnace Controls[XENO:n ]
to restore the transporter.
Talk to Vivian in Whitewing Palace.

The transporter is working again,[XENO:n ]
and you rescued the people who were trapped.
Help with research into monster ecology.

Defeat 5 [System:Color name=item ]Cruz Paguurs[/System:Color][XENO:n ]
in Eryth Sea.

You fulfilled an Achamoth resident's request.[XENO:n ]
You fought monsters and reported on their ecology.
Help with research into monster ecology.

Defeat 3 [System:Color name=item ]Eryth Ansels[/System:Color][XENO:n ]
in Eryth Sea.

You fulfilled an Achamoth resident's request.[XENO:n ]
You fought monsters and reported on their ecology.
Help with research into monster ecology.

Defeat 2 [System:Color name=item ]Ciconia Ekidnos[/System:Color][XENO:n ]
in Eryth Sea.

You fulfilled an Achamoth resident's request.[XENO:n ]
You fought monsters and reported on their ecology.

His family apparently saw many monsters outside.[XENO:n ]
It'll take time to dispatch the guards,[XENO:n ]
so he wants you to go in their place.

Defeat 3 [System:Color name=item ]Chloro Laias[/System:Color]
[XENO:n ]in Eryth Sea.

You completed the Achamoth guard's request.[XENO:n ]
You defeated the monsters that his family saw.

Monsters have apparently appeared in another place.[XENO:n ]
It'll take time to dispatch the guards,[XENO:n ]
so he wants you to go in their place.

Defeat 5 [System:Color name=item ]Stella Eks[/System:Color]
[XENO:n ]in Eryth Sea.

You completed the Achamoth guard's request and[XENO:n ]
defeated the monsters he asked you to.

Monsters have been breeding at an alarming rate.[XENO:n ]
It'll take time to dispatch the guards,[XENO:n ]
so he wants you to go in their place.

Defeat 1 [System:Color name=item ]Racti Lexos[/System:Color]
[XENO:n ]in Eryth Sea.

You fulfilled an Achamoth guard's request.[XENO:n ]
You defeated the rapidly multiplying monsters.

You've been asked to defeat monsters[XENO:n ]
to keep Imperial Capital Achamoth safe.

Defeat 5 [System:Color name=item ]Unine Fuudis[/System:Color]
[XENO:n ]in Eryth Sea.

You fulfilled an Achamoth resident's request.[XENO:n ]
The risk of danger to Achamoth has decreased.

You've been asked to defeat monsters[XENO:n ]
to keep Imperial Capital Achamoth safe.

Defeat 2 [System:Color name=item ]Tocos Orugas[/System:Color][XENO:n ]
in Eryth Sea.

You fulfilled an Achamoth resident's request.[XENO:n ]
The risk of danger to Achamoth has decreased.

You've been asked to defeat monsters[XENO:n ]
to keep Imperial Capital Achamoth safe.

Defeat 1 [System:Color name=item ]Pelargos Ekidno[/System:Color][XENO:n ]
in Eryth Sea.

You fulfilled an Achamoth resident's request.[XENO:n ]
The risk of danger to Achamoth has decreased.

The minister assigned a task through a guard.[XENO:n ]
Defeat the monsters on Soltnar Seal Island.

Defeat 3 [System:Color name=item ]Somati Spicals[/System:Color][XENO:n ]
in Eryth Sea.

You fulfilled an Achamoth guard's request.[XENO:n ]
You defeated the monsters on Soltnar Seal Island.

The minister assigned a task through a guard.[XENO:n ]
Eliminate the monsters on Soltnar Seal Island.

Defeat 4 [System:Color name=item ]Tussock Spicals[/System:Color][XENO:n ]
in Eryth Sea.

You fulfilled an Achamoth guard's request.[XENO:n ]
You defeated the monsters on Soltnar Seal Island.

The minister assigned a task through a guard.[XENO:n ]
Defeat the monsters on Soltnar Seal Island.

Defeat 5 [System:Color name=item ]Otol Spicals[/System:Color][XENO:n ]
in Eryth Sea.

You fulfilled an Achamoth guard's request.[XENO:n ]
You defeated the monsters on Soltnar Seal Island.
Complete the monster-slaying assignment for her boyfriend.

Near Secluded Island in Eryth Sea,[XENO:n ]
defeat [System:Color name=item ]Proper Bandaz[/System:Color] (night, during shooting stars only).

You fulfilled an Achamoth resident's request.[XENO:n ]
You completed the assignment for her boyfriend.

A resident was reportedly attacked by an unfamiliar[XENO:n ]
monster. Defeat it before it causes more harm.

On Hovering Reef 10 in Eryth Sea,[XENO:n ]
defeat [System:Color name=item ]Tempestuous Edegia[/System:Color] (night only).

You fulfilled an Achamoth resident's request.[XENO:n ]
You defeated the monster and secured the area.

His senior saddled him with an impossible assignment.[XENO:n ]
Complete the monster-slaying assignment for the poor man.

On Hovering Reef 7 in Eryth Sea,[XENO:n ]
defeat [System:Color name=item ]Peeling Kircheis[/System:Color].

You completed the Achamoth guard's request[XENO:n ]
and completed the quest for him.

A monster appeared before a resident out on a walk.[XENO:n ]
It'll endanger others too, so go defeat it.

Near Anu Shore in Eryth Sea,[XENO:n ]
defeat [System:Color name=item ]Lightspeed Sonid[/System:Color].

You fulfilled an Achamoth resident's request.[XENO:n ]
You defeated the requested monster and removed the danger.

He wants to thank a colleague who helped him after[XENO:n ]
a mistake at work, but lacks the materials for a gift.[XENO:n ]
Gather the materials for him.

Obtain 2 [System:Color name=item ]Glossy Grady Fans[/System:Color][XENO:n ]
from Luna Gradys in Eryth Sea.

You fulfilled an Achamoth resident's request.[XENO:n ]
The materials were gathered and the gift delivered.

She tried to make a dance costume but seems to lack[XENO:n ]
materials. Gather them to finish the wild outfit.

Obtain 5 [System:Color name=item ]Oruga Grass Skirts[/System:Color][XENO:n ]
from Orugas in Makna Forest.

You fulfilled an Achamoth resident's request.[XENO:n ]
The wild dance costume is complete.

He wants to give his child a doll as he has little time[XENO:n ]
for them due to work, but lacks cloth for its clothes.[XENO:n ]
Gather the materials for his child.

Obtain 3 pairs of [System:Color name=item ]Oruga Demon Pants[/System:Color][XENO:n ]
from Orugas in Eryth Sea.

You fulfilled an Achamoth guard's request.[XENO:n ]
The doll for his child now has clothes.

He lacks materials for an instrument to play love songs.[XENO:n ]
Gather the materials for him.

Obtain 2 [System:Color name=item ]Lexos Rainbow Beards[/System:Color][XENO:n ]
from Racti Lexos in Eryth Sea.

You fulfilled an Achamoth resident's request.[XENO:n ]
His handmade instrument is complete.

Apparently fibre-rich food can ease bloating.[XENO:n ]
She's having trouble moving, so gather the collectible[XENO:n ]
items in her place.

Collect 3 portions of [System:Color name=item ]Gold Burdock[/System:Color][XENO:n ]
in Eryth Sea.

You fulfilled an Achamoth resident's request.[XENO:n ]
Her stomach seems to feel better now.

His favourite body pillow seems to have broken.[XENO:n ]
Gather the collectible items for him.

Collect 2 [System:Color name=item ]White Tails[/System:Color][XENO:n ]
in Eryth Sea.

You completed the Achamoth resident's request[XENO:n ]
and collected all the items he asked for.

She wants to cheer up her friend's downhearted mother.[XENO:n ]
Gather the collectibles to help her in this kind gesture.

Collect 5 [System:Color name=item ]Stardrops[/System:Color][XENO:n ]
in Imperial Capital Achamoth.

You fulfilled an Achamoth resident's request.[XENO:n ]
Touched by her kindness, the woman seems a bit happier.

Materials for maintaining flying machines are running low.[XENO:n ]
Soon it won't be possible to maintain them properly.[XENO:n ]
Gather the collectible items for him.

Collect 2 [System:Color name=item ]Spiral Lamps[/System:Color][XENO:n ]
in the High Entia Tomb.

You fulfilled an Achamoth resident's request.[XENO:n ]
The flying machines have been properly serviced.

He dropped a keepsake from his late mother while[XENO:n ]
out walking. He apparently has no idea where[XENO:n ]
he lost it. Look for this precious keepsake.

On 2F of Imperial Capital Achamoth,[XENO:n ]
obtain [System:Color name=item ]Mother's Necklace[/System:Color].

You fulfilled an Achamoth resident's request.[XENO:n ]
You returned his late mother's lost keepsake.

A resident has lost the ring he planned to give to[XENO:n ]
his girlfriend. Find the very precious item for him.

Inside the palace in Imperial Capital Achamoth,[XENO:n ]
obtain the [System:Color name=item ]Silver Ring[/System:Color].

You fulfilled an Achamoth resident's request.[XENO:n ]
You delivered the ring meant for his girlfriend.

He lost a memento he received after befriending[XENO:n ]
a travelling merchant.[XENO:n ]
It's important to him, so find it.

On 1F of Imperial Capital Achamoth,[XENO:n ]
obtain the [System:Color name=item ]Merchant Memento[/System:Color].

You fulfilled an Achamoth resident's request.[XENO:n ]
You returned his memento safely.

The dear amulet this child got when moving is missing.[XENO:n ]
It's irreplaceable, so they really want to find it.[XENO:n ]
Look for it for them.

On 1F of Imperial Capital Achamoth,[XENO:n ]
obtain the [System:Color name=item ]Health Amulet[/System:Color].

You fulfilled an Achamoth resident's request.[XENO:n ]
You found the lost amulet and returned it.
